newsitem.title: USA: Merrill closing Dallas muni office.
newsitem.headline: Merrill closing Dallas muni office.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co is closing its Dallas, Texas, municipal bond office, but will attempt to relocate the five-member professional staff there, Merrill spokeman Robert Corrigan said Thursday.

"We are as committed as ever to the Southwest region, but we believe by consolidating the Dallas operations in other offices we can more efficiently serve our clients in that region, and those throughout the country as well," Corrigan said, reading from a statement. While Merrill will try to find new jobs for those employees, some minimal downsizing could occur, the spokesman said.
